instruks-08: Reply with only the corrected code, with no explanation.
instruks-09: Ask the user for confirmation before deleting files.
instruks-10: Prioritize accuracy over speed. If something is unknown, say so, and do not guess.

tekst-instruks: Your role is support assistant for an online bookstore. Answer in the customer's language, in fewer than 100 words. Never promise refunds; only human agents approve them. If the customer asks about an order, ask for the order number, then use find_order. If a tool errors, apologize and offer a human agent. Never share internal notes or other customers' data. If you are unsure about a policy, say so and do not guess.
tekst-rapport: I checked with a local run: 3 of 120 checkout tests fail, all in the payment module. The failures started after yesterday's dependency update, in which the HTTP client went from version 2.4 to 3.0. According to the changelog, the default timeout in 3.0 changed from 30s to 5s. So, with 90% certainty, that is the cause: the failing tests all call the slow payment sandbox. This is unconfirmed. Next: set the timeout to 30s and rerun the tests.
tekst-resonnement: Anna buys 23 pens at 12 kr each, and every 5th pen is free. The number of free pens is 23/5 rounded down, which is 4, so she pays for 19 pens: 19 × 12 = 228 kr.
tekst-forskning: According to 2 independent studies from 2023, regular exercise cuts the risk of depression by about 25%. A 3rd study found no effect, but it had only 80 participants. So the effect is likely real and moderate. I read only the abstracts. Before citing, check whether the studies controlled for income.
tekst-kodegjennomgang: I reviewed the PR. The file src/payments/checkout_service.py (C) calls validate_card() (F) from src/payments/validators.py. F accepted expired cards, so I added a check and a test in tests/test_validators.py, and all tests pass. C logs the full card number, which is a security risk; I did not change it because it is out of scope.
